portedFromTheOracle.index: src/physics.js updateNarcosis() and smoothstep(), with src/constants.js NARC_*: the target is smoothstep(NARC_ONSET_BAR 1.5, NARC_FULL_BAR 8) of the narcotic partial pressure, (1 - fHe) of narcosisGas() times 1 + depth/10; the index moves by (target - index) * NARC_RAMP_UP (0.012) or NARC_RAMP_DOWN (0.025) * dive seconds, clamped to 0..1. narcosisGas() is the gas updateTissues() breathes, and so is the model's: the active cylinder, the loop at its actual PO2, the diluent after a bailout.
portedFromTheOracle.timer: narcosisKOTime counts the dive seconds with the index at NARC_KO_THRESHOLD (0.95) or more and is set to 0 below it; NARC_KO_TIME (30 s) ends the dive in updateDiving(), after hypoxia and before surfacing with a ceiling.
portedFromTheOracle.order: updateDiving() calls updateNarcosis() right after updateCNS() and before updateCCR()'s returns, so a step a rebreather failure ends still moves the index and the timer.
portedFromTheOracle.text: STRINGS.{en,de}.gameOverReasons and gameOverInfo['NITROGEN NARCOSIS — UNCONSCIOUSNESS'], taken verbatim from src/constants.js by evaluating it in a Node vm, the label in the catalogue's sentence case, as gameOver.reason.nitrogenNarcosis and gameOver.info.nitrogenNarcosis.*; anchored under NARCOSIS-001 and GAMEOVER-001 for both locales.

decisions: The index is legacy's explicit step per frame, not an exact exponential: it depends on the step length as legacy's does, and the client's frames are legacy's frames.
The index lives on the dive state beside cnsPercent, an exposure the HUD can read; the KO timer lives with the failure timers.

Legacy's narcosis also impairs the controls (dropped inputs above 0.3, a random drift above 0.45, both from Math.random). Not in this change: it alters the client's controls and needs the model's seeded random state; a follow-up.

Save v15: older saves resume the index and the timer at zero, whatever their payload carries; legacy saves keep narcosisIndex and narcosisKOTime and resume at zero without them. Validation requires an index within 0..1 and a non-negative finite timer.
parity: narcosis-air-65m is replayed tick by tick at the depth legacy read back: the index and the KO timer at every checkpoint through the count, the reset at 45 m and the count again, the dive going on until legacy's last tick and ending on it. A second replay resumes from legacy's checkpoint with the timer at 12 s and fails on the same tick. The index also matches legacy at every checkpoint of air-18m-30min, trimix-dcs-above-stop, trimix-dcs-surfaced, wreck-thirds, buoyancy-vent-inflate-12m, barotrauma-runaway-ascent-30m, tec-switch-21m and ccr-30m-30min. Not compared: the recordings whose cylinder switch or bailout is a key read inside an ordinary tick.
